summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state set and cleared in run's run_app coroutine (try/finally). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 10 tests, all passing when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the generated src (the shared venv imports textual from base/). Four pre-existing async tests in test_message_pump.py and test_unmount.py fail with "async def functions are not natively supported", which appears to be an environment issue; not verified against the untouched tree. Nothing committed.
